system_description.narrative_title: Middle East escalation disrupts oil flows, sparking global fuel-price shock
system_description.narrative_summary: A surge in attacks and territorial gains by Iran-backed proxies (notably the Houthis) and retaliatory regional moves have disrupted critical maritime chokepoints and pipelines (Hormuz, Bab al‑Mandeb, East‑West pipeline), reducing effective oil flows and straining refining/logistics capacity. That disruption is feeding a feedback loop: tighter physical supply -> higher crude and diesel prices -> economic strain and market volatility -> accelerated military, diplomatic and sanction responses that further complicate recovery of normal flows. The system is open: external inputs (military actions, sanctions, alternative supply, weather, demand swings) and outputs (oil/derivative shipments, prices, inflation, geopolitical alignments) continuously change system behavior.
system_description.scope: The global oil supply chain vulnerabilities caused by Middle East hostilities: maritime chokepoints (Strait of Hormuz, Bab al‑Mandeb, Red Sea), pipelines and refineries (East‑West pipeline, regional refineries), tanker and shipping operations, inventories and refining capacity, oil/fuel markets (crude and diesel), principal state and proxy actors (Iran, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Houthis, US, Russia), sanctions/military actions, and near‑term economic impacts (fuel prices, inflation, trade flows).
system_description.super_system: Global geopolitical-economic system (international energy security embedded in global trade, finance and macroeconomic stability)
adjacent_subsystems: Global maritime shipping and chokepoint security
International oil & refined-fuel markets (production, refining, inventories, futures)
Regional Middle East geopolitics and proxy warfare/diplomacy
Global financial markets and macroeconomic transmission (currencies, equities, inflation, trade)

variables.name: Crude oil physical flow rate
variables.description: Rate of crude oil physically transported through the global supply network measured in barrels per day.

variables.name: Refined fuel flow rate
variables.description: Rate of movement of refined petroleum products (diesel, gasoline, jet fuel) through refining and distribution channels measured in barrels per day.

variables.name: Maritime chokepoint operational capacity
variables.description: Functional throughput capacity of major maritime transit chokepoints measured in equivalent barrels per day.

variables.name: Maritime transit rate
variables.description: Number of vessel transits or oil shipments passing through key sea routes per unit time.

variables.name: Tanker availability
variables.description: Amount of deployable tanker cargo capacity available for oil transport measured in barrels.

variables.name: Shipping risk premium
variables.description: Additional per‑unit transport cost reflecting perceived security and insurance risk for maritime oil shipments.

variables.name: Oil market price level
variables.description: prevailing market price level of crude oil benchmarks measured in dollars per barrel.

variables.name: Price volatility level
variables.description: Magnitude of short‑term fluctuations in crude and refined fuel prices, measured as realized or implied volatility.

variables.name: Total oil inventories
variables.description: Aggregate stocks of crude and refined products held across commercial and strategic storage measured in barrels.

variables.name: Refinery utilization rate
variables.description: Share of global refining capacity currently operational, expressed as a percentage of nameplate capacity.

variables.name: Pipeline operational capacity
variables.description: Aggregate throughput capacity of major oil pipelines measured in barrels per day.

variables.name: Conflict intensity
variables.description: Frequency and severity of hostile incidents and military actions that affect energy infrastructure and shipping safety.

variables.name: Sanctions restriction intensity
variables.description: Degree and scope of legal and regulatory restrictions on energy transactions, logistics, and financing.

variables.name: Diplomatic engagement level
variables.description: Level of active diplomatic negotiation, mediation, and multilateral coordination aimed at de‑escalation and reopening routes.

variables.name: Alternative supply response rate
variables.description: Rate at which alternative supply sources and rerouting adjustments are mobilized to replace disrupted flows, measured in barrels per day per time unit.

variables.name: Fuel distribution delay
variables.description: Average delay in delivery times for refined fuels from refineries to end markets due to logistical disruptions, measured in days.

catalysts.title: Houthi control of Bab el-Mandeb continues
catalysts.description: Houthis consolidating control of Bab el-Mandeb and nearby islands, sustaining a choke on Red Sea shipping and oil transits.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Houthis seize Red Sea coast', 'Houthis reach Dhubab on Bab el-Mandeb', 'take effective control of key Red Sea chokepoint'.

catalysts.title: Prolonged East‑West pipeline outage in Saudi Arabia
catalysts.description: Repeated attacks have shut the East‑West bypass pipeline; risk of extended outage threatens several percent of global supply.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Saudi Arabia shuts key oil pipeline', 'pipeline outage threatens loss of 4% of global oil supply', 'shut down after attacks.'

catalysts.title: Escalation of naval attacks near Strait of Hormuz
catalysts.description: Repeated strikes and near‑misses on vessels in Hormuz and nearby waters increase naval confrontations and shipping hazard levels.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Vessel struck in Strait of Hormuz', 'U.S. strikes Iranian oil tankers', 'close calls on U.S. warships'.

catalysts.title: Gulf‑Iran talks on Strait of Hormuz reopening
catalysts.description: Diplomatic negotiations (Oman‑mediated/Gulf‑Iran) aimed at a Hormuz deal could ease tensions if held or tighten them if stalled.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Iran, Gulf states to meet in push for Hormuz deal', 'Oman meeting postponed', 'Iran says reopening depends on U.S. conditions.'

catalysts.title: U.S. weighing Defense Production Act for refining
catalysts.description: White House consideration of DPA measures to expand US refining capacity could accelerate refined fuel output over coming months.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'White House weighs how to use Defense Production Act to expand US oil refining capacity.'

catalysts.title: Israel‑Lebanon talks in Rome (October)
catalysts.description: Scheduled talks between Israel and Lebanon in Rome could modestly reduce northern front tensions if progress is made.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Israel and Lebanon to meet in Rome in October, US State Department official says.'
